(Translated by PDA) First, we think you should check that the Quest Screen works.

This is a trial run, so just send a small amount of power. Power is also needed to run our faction's equipment, and since the power supply has been unstable lately, we may demand power from you in the future.
ze.quest.329.title: H2O
ze.quest.329.subtitle: Submit Water
ze.quest.329.des:
(Translated by PDA) First, we think you should check that the Quest Screen works.

This is a trial run, so just send a small amount of water. Besides basic drinking water, water can be split into oxygen and hydrogen through electrolysis, so we may keep asking you for water.
ze.quest.330.title: Galaxy Peace Company
ze.quest.330.subtitle: Credit Points
ze.quest.330.des:
(Translated by PDA) Excellent. Exchange with our faction should now be no big problem. But bartering alone won't cut it forever, so allow us to introduce the currency accepted across the entire universe, including our faction.

Credit Points are used as currency in alien trade. We recommend earning them through deals with us first. Once you do, other teams in our faction will reach out to you as well.
ze.quest.331.title: It All Started With a Bean
ze.quest.331.subtitle: Bio Research Team
ze.quest.331.des:
(Translated by PDA) The Galactic Union Bio Research Team mainly conducts research on living organisms.

We are very interested in the creatures of the Overworld, ancient creatures, and mutants. If you excavate fossils or provide specimens of mutant creatures, we will reward you. Interested?
ze.quest.332.title: Isekai'd
ze.quest.332.subtitle: Dimensional Ecosystem Research Team
ze.quest.332.des:
(Translated by PDA) The Galactic Ecosystem Research Team studies the ecosystems of many dimensions.

The Overworld is a planet of possibility where many dimensions can intersect. If you explore various dimensions and provide us with specimens, we will reward you.
ze.quest.333.title: Minecraft: Nether Under Overworld
ze.quest.333.subtitle: Netherrack
ze.quest.333.des:
(Translated by PDA) They say that if you dig down through the Overworld to bedrock, you get dragged into the Nether by some unknown dimensional force. Or you can build a portal frame out of obsidian and light it on fire, and a portal to that place opens up.

We need specimens from there.
ze.quest.334.title: The Three Stooges
ze.quest.334.subtitle: Wither
ze.quest.334.des:
(Translated by PDA) When we analyzed the specimens you provided, we learned something interesting. If you place withered skeletons on top of soul sand, a new creature awakens through magical power.

It's still only a hypothesis, but we believe you're the one who can prove it.
ze.quest.335.title: That Big Body! It Must Have Tons of Netherite!
ze.quest.335.subtitle: Netherite Monster
ze.quest.335.des:
(Translated by PDA) When we analyzed the specimens you provided, we learned something interesting. In the distant past, ancient intelligent beings existed in the Nether and seem to have advanced to the point of building factories. What caught our eye is the being they made out of Netherite.

Our research team is currently debating whether that being is a living creature or a machine.
ze.quest.336.title: Ash to Ash, and Beyond
ze.quest.336.subtitle: Ignis
ze.quest.336.des:
(Translated by PDA) When we analyzed the specimens you provided, we learned something interesting. We found that the Nether was destroyed after the dead entered it. And after a certain being appeared, the whereabouts of the dead became unknown.

Given that it's the being that made those who destroyed an ancient civilization disappear, we strongly recommend preparing thoroughly.
ze.quest.337.title: The End Is Just a New Beginning
ze.quest.337.subtitle: End Stone
ze.quest.337.des:
(Translated by PDA) The End, the final destination of all dimensions, is not an easy place to reach. Fortunately, thanks to the efforts of those in the Overworld and you, a portal leading there has been opened.

We need specimens from there.
ze.quest.338.title: Haraguro
ze.quest.338.subtitle: Ender Guardian
ze.quest.338.des:
(Translated by PDA) A certain citadel has taken root on the outskirts of the End's central island. The lord of the castle should be on its lowest floor.

They look like beings of the End on the surface, but after comparing them with the specimens you sent, it turned out they aren't. For what reason did they settle there, I wonder.
ze.quest.339.title: Dovahkiin
ze.quest.339.subtitle: Ender Dragon
ze.quest.339.des:
(Translated by PDA) We learned that the creature guarding the End from outsiders on the central island is guarding its own egg.

Since it broods the egg we could assume it's a female, but the hypothesis that it may be a male guarding the last treasure left by his mate is regarded as the established theory in our research team.

Thank you for providing us with so many valuable specimens so far. If you're willing to help us further, use the Teleportation Core we'll send as your reward to open a door to yet another dimension.
ze.quest.340.title: Conquering the Forest Where the Sun Never Sets
ze.quest.340.subtitle: Twilight Forest
ze.quest.340.des:
(Translated by PDA) The forest where twilight perpetually lingers is a dimension where magical forces are even stronger than in the Overworld. Even in our Galactic Union, that dimension is considered a fictional one that only appears in imagination or fairy tales, but we think otherwise.

Find the creatures that live there and provide us with specimens.
ze.quest.341.title: Military Contracting
ze.quest.341.subtitle: Combat Support Team
ze.quest.341.des:
(Translated by PDA) Our Combat Support Team supplies and distributes materiel for the security of the Union.

Weapons and supplies needed for combat are always in demand. If you help us, we will pay out an appropriate reward.
ze.quest.342.title: The Most Primitive Weapons
ze.quest.342.subtitle: Classic Weapons
ze.quest.342.des: (Translated by PDA) Our Galactic Union is a place woven together from many races and cultural factions. There are quite a few places where guns can't be used. So surprisingly, there are quite a few cases where swords, bows, and arrows are needed.
ze.quest.343.title: Doping Part 1
ze.quest.343.subtitle: Potions
ze.quest.343.des: (Translated by PDA) In combat, drugs are just as important as weapons. They can heal wounds quickly and push a soldier's physical abilities to the limit.
ze.quest.344.title: Writing the Manual Part 1
ze.quest.344.subtitle: Zombies and Skeletons
ze.quest.344.des: (Translated by PDA) Due to the polluted environment, infected humans, zombies and skeletons, exist in various parts of the galaxy. So that we can deal with them more effectively, please hunt them and provide us with the data.
ze.quest.345.title: The Second Amendment
ze.quest.345.subtitle: Self-Defense Weapons
ze.quest.345.des:
(Translated by PDA) Unless it's a special situation, naturally it's best to use firearms. It's important that even ordinary citizens carry a weapon whenever possible. Even if it's not an automatic weapon, a pistol and a shotgun are judged to be sufficient.

Unlike swords and bows, firearms are strictly controlled in our Union. If it has ever been in someone's hands, we won't accept it.
ze.quest.346.title: Doping Part 2
ze.quest.346.subtitle: Syringe
ze.quest.346.des: (Translated by PDA) With a syringe, you can inject a potion into the body quickly and see the effects fast.
ze.quest.347.title: Writing the Manual Part 2
ze.quest.347.subtitle: Husks and Strays
ze.quest.347.des: (Translated by PDA) Some monsters can survive even in special environments. They're hard to see in ordinary environments, but conversely, there's a lack of information about them.
ze.quest.348.title: Tactical Choice
ze.quest.348.subtitle: Regular Army Weapons
ze.quest.348.des:
(Translated by PDA) Armaments used by soldiers rather than civilians are of a higher grade.

Unlike swords and bows, firearms are strictly controlled in our Union. If it has ever been in someone's hands, we won't accept it.
ze.quest.349.title: Doping Part 3
ze.quest.349.subtitle: Reinforced Syringe
ze.quest.349.des: (Translated by PDA) Has a better effect than ordinary syringes.
ze.quest.350.title: Writing the Manual Part 3
ze.quest.350.subtitle: Mutant Zombies and Skeletons
ze.quest.350.des:
(Translated by PDA) Among ordinary monsters, mutants appear with an extremely rare chance. They're very powerful and hard to subdue properly.

If you have trouble finding them, get a potion called 'Chemical X' from another team and throw it at monsters. If you can handle it, that is.
ze.quest.351.title: Department Store
ze.quest.351.subtitle: Daily Necessities Supply Team
ze.quest.351.des:
(Translated by PDA) Our Daily Necessities Supply Team supplies relief goods and luxury items to most Union-affiliated factions.

If you supply drinking water, food, and the like, we will give you an appropriate reward and teach you how to produce tea, coffee, and more.
ze.quest.352.title: Carb Power
ze.quest.352.subtitle: Bread and Baked Potato
ze.quest.352.des: (Translated by PDA) In some hard-to-supply places of our galactic faction, we distribute basic staples like bread and potatoes.
ze.quest.353.title: Drinking Water
ze.quest.353.subtitle: Water
ze.quest.353.des: (Translated by PDA) Most living things need water. You don't need to worry much about the water quality. We can just purify it ourselves.
ze.quest.354.title: For the Taste Buds
ze.quest.354.subtitle: Sugar and Salt
ze.quest.354.des: (Translated by PDA) Not strictly necessary, but they're ingredients needed to eat higher-quality food.
ze.quest.355.title: For That Money You Could-
ze.quest.355.subtitle: Meatball Pasta and Fried Rice
ze.quest.355.des: (Translated by PDA) Most members of galactic factions can eat above-average food.. if they pay a small fee, that is.
ze.quest.356.title: Tea Time
ze.quest.356.subtitle: Green Tea
ze.quest.356.des:
(Translated by PDA) Tea isn't an essential element, but it's useful when you want physical and mental stability and rest.

You should have received tea seeds as a reward for a previous request. If you lost them, you can pay a bit of money and buy them again.

Plant the tea seeds on dirt and wait, and a tea plant will grow. Once the tea plant is fully grown, use shears to cut the leaves (with right-click) to get tea leaves, and that tea plant's growth stage will reset to the beginning.

Note that a fully grown tea plant changes its leaf color as time passes, and each color yields a different tea. For now, start by getting the first color, green tea leaves, and steeping them to make green tea.
ze.quest.357.title: Diabetes-Inducing Substance
ze.quest.357.subtitle: Chocolate Bar
ze.quest.357.des:
(Translated by PDA) Chocolate is a cause of many complications including diabetes, but quite a few people would rather starve than go without it.

Heat and mix sugar, cocoa beans, and milk to make chocolate, and compress it into a chocolate bar, which makes a snack that's easy to carry around.
ze.quest.358.title: The Process of Making Caffeine
ze.quest.358.subtitle: Coffee Bush
ze.quest.358.des:
(Translated by PDA) Most faction members drink coffee for work efficiency. The number of people who drink it even when not working is rising quite a bit, too.

You should have received coffee beans as a reward for a previous request. If you lost them, you can pay a bit of money and buy them again.

Coffee beans need a rather unusual growth process. Plant the coffee beans on basalt, and they grow by absorbing other fully grown crops nearby. Once a coffee bush has grown to some extent, coffee cherries appear on it, and you can harvest them with right-click.
ze.quest.359.title: Barista
ze.quest.359.subtitle: Coffee
ze.quest.359.des: (Translated by PDA) Process coffee cherries on a cutting board or the like to get coffee beans, then steep them and you get coffee.
ze.quest.360.title: Tech Steve Save The World
ze.quest.360.subtitle: Engineer Team
ze.quest.360.des:
(Translated by PDA) We handle the technology of the galactic factions.

We're always short on machine parts and fuel. If you help us, we will give you an appropriate reward and materials that are hard to find in the Overworld.
ze.quest.361.title: Artificial Sun, Sort Of
ze.quest.361.subtitle: Fusion Reactor
ze.quest.361.des:
Producing power through nuclear fission is fine, but you always have to worry about radiation leaks. So the alternative method of generating power is nuclear fusion.

Fusion basically works with D-T fuel and a large burst of energy when starting it up.
ze.quest.361.des2:
The fusion reactor is relatively simple in shape (the materials, not so much).

It's basically spherical, with the outline made of Fusion Reactor Frames and the rest made of a Fusion Reactor Logic Adapter, Ports, and a Laser Focus Matrix. Like other structures, you can use Reactor Glass for the leftover parts.

Only one Laser Focus Matrix is needed, and you need at least 2 Fusion Reactor Ports, but the recommended number is 3, and if you use the reactor in the other mode we'll explain later, you'll need to install up to 4 ports.
ze.quest.362.title: High-Heat Frustration Beam
ze.quest.362.subtitle: Lasers and Laser Amplifier
ze.quest.362.des:
To start fusion, a high-power laser is needed temporarily.

Place a Laser Amplifier so it faces the reactor's Laser Focus Matrix, and place a laser facing another side of the Laser Amplifier.

Right-click the Laser Amplifier to open the GUI, set the redstone control mode to normal or pulse, and power the laser to charge the Laser Amplifier. To start fusion, the Laser Amplifier must be supplied with at least 400,000,000 (400M) FE of laser (power).

Laser Amplifiers can be placed in a long single row, and you can fill all the remaining area with lasers to speed up laser charging. However, you need space to give a redstone signal to the Laser Amplifier closest to the Laser Focus Matrix. If you just fire the laser, it destroys ordinary blocks, so be careful when placing it.
ze.quest.363.title: Water Holds Power
ze.quest.363.subtitle: Electric Pump and Filter Upgrade
ze.quest.363.des:
The Electric Pump is a good liquid pump, but what sets it apart from the others is that with a Filter Upgrade installed, it can extract heavy water. This heavy water is the key ingredient in producing D-T fuel, the fusion fuel.

Electrolyze heavy water in an Electrolytic Separator to split it into deuterium and oxygen, then mix the deuterium with tritium in a Chemical Infuser to produce D-T fuel.

For tritium, evaporate water into brine, and brine into liquid lithium, in a Thermal Evaporation Plant, then vaporize the liquid lithium in a Rotary Condensentrator to convert it into lithium. Then process the lithium in a Solar Neutron Activator, and you get tritium.

Yes, all of this only needs water and power.
ze.quest.364.title: Butterfly Effect
ze.quest.364.subtitle: Hohlraum
ze.quest.364.des:
If the D-T fuel and the 400M FE laser are ready, the time to start the reactor is right around the corner.

But you have to decide. You can prepare the D-T fuel in advance and feed it to the reactor, but if you supply deuterium and tritium to the reactor separately, the reactor will process and consume even more D-T fuel by itself. That's why the recommended number of reactor ports is 3.

Anyway, once you've decided, supply the fuel, connect the output to a suitable energy storage device, and then, finally, you still don't fire the laser. Because there's one real final step left. You need an item called the Hohlraum. Fill the Hohlraum with D-T fuel and install it in the Fusion Reactor Logic Adapter, and you're really ready.

When you fire the laser, the fusion reactor consumes D-T fuel to produce enormous amounts of power. If the reactor stops running because D-T fuel runs short, you must supply the Hohlraum with D-T fuel again and gather a 400M FE laser once more. Prepare at least enough fuel to produce that much power.
ze.quest.364.des2:
The fusion reactor actually has two ways to operate. One is the air-cooled method I explained earlier, and the other is the water-cooled method.

Water cooling needs to be connected to an Industrial Turbine, similar to a fission reactor. Yes, that means you need extra ports for coolant and for outputting spent coolant. If you manage to use this method well, the reactor's own power generation and the turbine's additional power generation combine for even more power.. but it'll be quite tricky. And

And if you use the water-cooled method, you can adjust the fuel consumption rate, but in that case you must craft and supply D-T fuel in advance. That's because the amount of D-T fuel the reactor can produce is fixed.
ze.quest.365.title: A Clump of Cogs
ze.quest.365.subtitle: Precision Mechanism
ze.quest.365.des:
(Translated by PDA) The Precision Mechanism, relatively simple yet serving many roles, is a core component of simple machines all over the galaxy.

Even a civilization with a basic level of technology can craft it easily. That's one of the reasons you can see them all over the Overworld.
ze.quest.366.title: Molten Rock
ze.quest.366.subtitle: Lava
ze.quest.366.des:
(Translated by PDA) Lava, one of the liquids that easily provides high heat, can be made by melting stone at high temperature and is also easily found in nature.

According to information from the Dimensional Ecosystem Research Team, lava is a common liquid in a place called the Nether. They say you can get lots of lava there.
ze.quest.367.title: Hunk of Iron
ze.quest.367.subtitle: Engineering Block
ze.quest.367.des: (Translated by PDA) Engineering Blocks are used as materials for machines of a higher tier than Create's. Being made of iron or steel, they're perfect for building huge, sturdy, and chunky machines.
ze.quest.368.title: Where Democracy Is Headed
ze.quest.368.subtitle: Diesel
ze.quest.368.des:
(Translated by PDA) This oil, obtained by refining petroleum, has a high combustion rate, making it excellent generator fuel.

It's a fuel mainly used by civilizations with considerable technology.
ze.quest.369.title: Totally Not Here for the Oil
ze.quest.369.subtitle: Steel Casing
ze.quest.369.des:
(Translated by PDA) This casing, based on steel and containing electronic circuits and precision machinery, is a component you could call the pinnacle of technology.

It can be crafted using petroleum coke, a petroleum byproduct, but if you can't afford that, it can be crafted in the Nether by spending a resource called Netherite. However, according to our information, Netherite may be harder to come by than petroleum coke.

If you've reached this tech level, buy some plastic from us and put our technologies to use.
ze.quest.370.title: Drive-Thru
ze.quest.370.subtitle: Liquid D-T Fuel
ze.quest.370.des:
(Translated by PDA) Most ships of the Galactic Union produce electricity through nuclear fusion. The fuel used then is D-T fuel.

For easy transport, it's usually converted to liquid form and stored.
ze.quest.371.title: Plasteel
ze.quest.371.subtitle: Plastic
ze.quest.371.des: You obtained their plastic from the Galactic Union. It can partly replace the Duroplast we used, and lets you craft machines that can only be made with this plastic.
ze.quest.372.title: Intro to Auto-Farming
ze.quest.372.subtitle: Pity Machine Frame
ze.quest.372.des:
Based on the Steel Casing, you can craft a Pity Machine Frame using treated wood and plastic.

It's the base component of the Galactic Union's automated farms and factories, and can later be upgraded to craft higher-grade machines.
ze.quest.373.title: Sluuuurp
ze.quest.373.subtitle: Fluid Extractor and Latex Processing Unit
ze.quest.373.des:
You can process plastic yourself.

Place a log in front of the Fluid Extractor and it extracts latex from the tree. Process that latex in the Latex Processing Unit to get dry rubber, and finally heat-treat it to complete the plastic.

The Fluid Extractor can run slowly even without electricity, but the Latex Processing Unit must run with power and water.
ze.quest.374.title: Unity
ze.quest.374.subtitle: Dissolution Chamber
ze.quest.374.des: A machine that combines multiple items and/or liquids to craft other materials. With it, you can craft useful tools or machines of the next tier.
ze.quest.375.title: Trauma Factory
ze.quest.375.subtitle: Mob Slaughter Factory
ze.quest.375.des:
Kills living creatures within the machine's front range and turns them into liquid meat and Pink Slime.

Friendly creatures like animals produce more Pink Slime than hostile creatures like monsters.
ze.quest.376.title: Adapting to Auto-Farming
ze.quest.376.subtitle: Simple Machine Frame
ze.quest.376.des: A machine frame you can craft in the Dissolution Chamber from a Pity Machine Frame, various materials, and latex.
ze.quest.377.title: Specializing in Auto-Farming
ze.quest.377.subtitle: Advanced Machine Frame
ze.quest.377.des: A machine frame you can craft in the Dissolution Chamber from a Simple Machine Frame, various materials, and Pink Slime.
ze.quest.378.title: Freeze! You Gotta Believe Me!
ze.quest.378.subtitle: Stasis Chamber
ze.quest.378.des: Freezes all living creatures within the machine's upper range and also heals them slightly for preservation. Thanks to a safety feature, humans aren't greatly affected.
ze.quest.379.title: Sticking a Straw in the Skull
ze.quest.379.subtitle: Fluid Laser Base and Laser Drill
ze.quest.379.des:
The Fluid Laser Base can extract specific liquids depending on the biome or target below the machine. Also, the color of the installed Laser Lens has to match the conditions.

Mainly, if you place a Wither (yes, that boss Wither I'm talking about) directly beneath the machine and install a purple Laser Lens, you can extract Ether Gas, which is used to craft the Supreme Machine Frame and add useful functions to other machines. (Due to technical issues, it can be transported and stored with fluid pipes, tanks, etc.)

To operate the Laser Base, you need to power a Laser Drill nearby, and the Laser Base must be within the Laser Drill's range.

For reference, once the Wither's health drops below a certain level, Ether extraction stops to prevent the Wither from dying. Wait for its health to recover in the Stasis Chamber.
ze.quest.380.title: The End of Auto-Farming
ze.quest.380.subtitle: Supreme Machine Frame
ze.quest.380.des:
You can craft the Supreme Machine Frame by processing an Advanced Machine Frame, various materials, and Ether Gas in the Dissolution Chamber.

You need to have the Fluid Laser Base obtain Ether Gas from a Wither. The Wither is dangerous, so it's important to neutralize it using a device like the Stasis Chamber. At that time, the Fluid Laser Base must be directly above the Wither to extract Ether Gas properly.

When Ether Gas is extracted from the Wither, it takes a bit of damage, but a Wither in the Stasis Chamber will recover again.
ze.quest.381.title: Real Auto-Farming
ze.quest.381.subtitle: Plant Gatherer and Plant Sower
ze.quest.381.des:
The Plant Gatherer harvests plants within the machine's front range. When cutting down trees, it also cuts the connected logs and leaves. Waste accumulates inside the machine every time it operates. And if you supply Ether, it replants after harvesting.

The Plant Sower plants plants (seeds, saplings, etc.) in the machine's upper range. Each color is shown in the machine's internal inventory, so you can set it to plant crops matching each color's position. However, by default the range is only 1 block, so this feature is meant to be used after a range upgrade.
ze.quest.382.title: Relatively Easy 5x Ore Processing
ze.quest.382.subtitle: Washing Plant, Fermenter, and Fluid Sieve
ze.quest.382.des:
Refining ores up to 5x with Mekanism technology requires a lot of machines and equipment. But with the Galactic Union's technology, you can refine them much more easily.

In the washing plant, mix the ore you want to refine with liquefied meat to make raw ore meat.

Then ferment the raw ore meat in the fermenter. You can choose how much to refine the ore. The higher the multiplier, the longer it takes and the pickier the required resources get.

Finally, strain the fermented ore meat through sand in the fluid sieve, and you can turn it into dust of that ore.

As you can see from the process, you need a factory that keeps killing living creatures running, and to reach the maximum 5x refining you have to extract ether gas from the Wither. On top of that, for technical reasons only some ores work with this process. Honestly, you're probably fine just using the regular Mekanism refining chain.
ze.quest.383.title: Turning Point
ze.quest.383.subtitle: Transcendent Engineering Component
ze.quest.383.des:
(Translated by PDA) Thanks to your steady help lately, our Galactic Union has benefited greatly. So after much discussion, big and small, we would like to give you a gift and make you an offer.

We are going to gift you a Transcendent Engineering Component. It is the culmination and core of all Galactic Union technology, so we only supply tiny amounts to forces we can trust. It is also the key part of a starship.

Yes, we want to help you escape the Overworld. Of course, the choice is yours. You may not want to leave the settlement you've grown attached to. That's why we're giving you a choice. Whatever you do with that component, we will not interfere. However, if you do want to escape the Overworld, keep it safe and use it as the final part of the escape ship.
ze.quest.384.title: Preparing to Build the Starship
ze.quest.384.subtitle: Mass Transport
ze.quest.384.des:
(Translated by PDA) Building a starship takes a huge amount of resources, and space too.

Don't worry. We can install a virtual construction system on your PDA. Gather resources and store them in the PDA, and the construction system will assemble the ship by itself according to an optimized blueprint.

So all you have to do now is gather the resources.
ze.quest.385.title: That Thing Is HUGE! It Must Eat Tons of Power!
ze.quest.385.subtitle: Starship Accumulator [Induction Matrix]
ze.quest.385.des: (Translated by PDA) It stores the starship's power. In case even the backup generators can't be started, a high-capacity storage facility is needed.
ze.quest.386.title: The Pinnacle of Alien Technology
ze.quest.386.subtitle: Starship Storage System [MEGA Storage Cell]
ze.quest.386.des:
(Translated by PDA) A system that stores various things (items, fluids, gases, etc.) inside the starship.

The AE system is not original Galactic Union technology. But even if we don't know its origin, we can still craft and use it.
ze.quest.387.title: The Origin of Life
ze.quest.387.subtitle: Starship Resource [Water]
ze.quest.387.des:
(Translated by PDA) No basic life form can do without it, and you can obtain oxygen from it through electrolysis.

In the Overworld, water can be produced infinitely with just two buckets, but once you leave for space, it loses that property.
ze.quest.388.title: Space Rations (Despair Edition)
ze.quest.388.subtitle: Starship Resource [Nutritional Paste]
ze.quest.388.des:
(Translated by PDA) In case you spend a long time aboard the starship, it's best to store food in the form of nutritional paste.

By the way, some factions also call it nutrient gruel.
ze.quest.389.title: Nutrient Gruel
ze.quest.389.subtitle: Nutrient Liquifier
ze.quest.389.des:
A machine that processes food into nutritional paste. The food's nutrients are destroyed in the process, but the essential nutrients remain, so it's recommended to process low-quality food into paste.

You can put the paste in a canteen and consume it whenever you like.
ze.quest.390.title: The Final Stage
ze.quest.390.subtitle: Starship Core Part [Transcendent Engineering Component]
ze.quest.390.des:
(Translated by PDA) If you've made it this far, we assume you have already decided to escape the Overworld. Now it is time to feed the final part, the Transcendent Engineering Component we gifted you, into the construction system.

With the Transcendent Engineering Component as the last piece, the construction system will begin building the starship. However, it will take a total of 8 days in Overworld time. Normally time wouldn't be a problem, but due to the special nature of the component, your PDA becomes a marker, and powerful creatures can warp to that location.

Good luck.
ze.quest.391.title: I Swear on the Truth.
ze.quest.391.subtitle: Day 1
ze.quest.391.des:
The first creature warps in.

(Translated by PDA) Until the Transcendent Engineering Component stabilizes, creatures will warp in above your head at roughly one-day intervals.

There are about 7 days left until stabilization. We hope you hold out until the end.
ze.quest.392.title: I Swear on the Calendar.
ze.quest.392.subtitle: Day 2
ze.quest.393.title: I Swear on Language.
ze.quest.393.subtitle: Day 3
ze.quest.394.title: I Swear on Value.
ze.quest.394.subtitle: Day 4
ze.quest.395.title: I Swear on the Rules.
ze.quest.395.subtitle: Day 5
ze.quest.396.title: I Swear on Meaning.
ze.quest.396.subtitle: Day 6
ze.quest.397.title: I Swear on Human Dignity.
ze.quest.397.subtitle: Day 7
ze.quest.398.title: The Journey So Far
ze.quest.398.subtitle: Day 8
ze.quest.398.des:
(Translated by PDA) The Transcendent Engineering Component has finally stabilized. The creature warps are over.

Wait just one more day, and the starship will finally be complete and you will be able to escape.
ze.quest.399.title: Coke Oven v2
ze.quest.399.subtitle: Advanced Coke Oven
ze.quest.399.des:
It's way cooler than the old Coke Oven. It also adds dedicated input/output ports, and you can attach add-ons that make the oven run faster.

To learn how to craft it, check the Engineer's Manual or search for Advanced Coke Oven.
ze.quest.400.title: Oven DLC
ze.quest.400.subtitle: Advanced Coke Oven Base Heater
ze.quest.400.des: It can be attached to both sides of the Advanced Coke Oven, and supplying it with power speeds up the oven.
ze.quest.401.title: Nice Meeting You, Now Never Meet Again.
ze.quest.401.subtitle: Escape Ending
ze.quest.401.des:
(Translated by PDA) The starship is complete. With the press of a single button, the construction system's starship will be summoned, pick you up, and escape the Overworld.

What comes after is up to you. You could return to your homeland, or set off to find another planet. Of course, you are also welcome to join our Galactic Union. In fact, we would prefer that.

(The developer's comment is on the next page]
ze.quest.401.des2:
Thank you for playing Zero to Engineering.

Story-wise, a starship that rips off an absurd amount of your resources should appear in front of you, but that's beyond my skills. Anyway, story-wise, you have escaped the Overworld.

Of course, that's just the story; you're still in the Overworld (or whatever dimension you're currently in). There's no problem at all with going back to finish quests you missed or chasing your own personal goals.

Anyway, thank you once again for playing. -Empty465(똻뛿뚏)
ze.quest.402.title: Let the Light Guide You
ze.quest.402.subtitle: Projector
ze.quest.402.des:
A tool that places a hologram to help you build the multiblock machine of your choice (Immersive Engineering family).

If you're using shaders, it's invisible due to a bug. We recommend turning shaders off briefly when using the projector.
ze.quest.403.title: Where the Heck Is It?
ze.quest.403.subtitle: Cataclysm Eyes
ze.quest.403.des:
To find the mighty beings of Cataclysm, rather than wandering aimlessly, we recommend crafting and using the Eye of the matching dungeon. Throw the eye and it will guide you to a nearby dungeon. Don't worry, these eyes don't break.

You can also interact with the respawner of an already defeated boss using the eye to revive that being. However, some bosses require their own special summoning items.
ze.quest.404.title: The Pain Begins
ze.quest.404.subtitle: Mysterious Signal
ze.quest.404.des:
(Mysterious Signal) We have confirmed that you obtained a Transcendent Engineering Component. And we know you are agonizing over what to use it for.

If you complete all the tasks we assign you, we will provide you with one Transcendent Engineering Component. That way, you can reach the ultimate technology and complete your starship at the same time.

The choice is yours.
ze.quest.405.title: Secret Ending
ze.quest.405.subtitle: Transcendent Engineering Component
ze.quest.405.des:
(Mysterious Signal) You have completed every task we assigned. It must have been a painful process, born of your greed to pick both when you were only supposed to choose one.

Claim the reward for your hard work.
ze.quest.406.title: Shedding the Weak Flesh
ze.quest.406.subtitle: Human Body Parts
ze.quest.406.des:
(Mysterious Signal) The human body is weak and barely expandable. A wise engineer considers it a virtue to improve it by replacing it with machinery.

Hand over the parts left over after being replaced with machines. You don't need to know what they're for.
ze.quest.407.title: The Art of the Extreme
ze.quest.407.subtitle: Nearly Broken Netherite Armor
ze.quest.407.des:
(Mysterious Signal) Armor made of netherite is extremely sturdy equipment, practically every soldier's dream. But we require a somewhat more peculiar state.

It must have Protection IV, Unbreaking III, and Mending at the very least, and the helmet, boots, and leggings must carry additional enchantments. The key point is that the armor must be on the verge of breaking.
ze.quest.408.title: The Eye That Stares Down Fear
ze.quest.408.subtitle: Eyes
ze.quest.408.des:
(Mysterious Signal) There are eyes used to head to specific locations or to perform rituals.

Please provide one of each.
ze.quest.409.title: Colonial Rule
ze.quest.409.subtitle: Colony Goods
ze.quest.409.des:
(Mysterious Signal) Provide products of colony-exclusive technology that you cannot craft yourself.

These are things you can obtain from a reasonably developed colony.
ze.quest.410.title: The Cake Is a Lie!
ze.quest.410.subtitle: Chocolate Cake
ze.quest.410.des: (Mysterious Signal) Cake always tells the truth. That's why we serve cake during depression counseling.
ze.quest.411.title: Is the Overworld's Sky Fake?
ze.quest.411.subtitle: Leaving the Atmosphere
ze.quest.411.des:
(Mysterious Signal) Think about it. If you fly straight up to the very end, surely you could escape the Overworld? Give it a try.

Any means will do. Reaching it with explosion recoil is fine, and so is using a jetpack. But... we recommend not expecting much from the result.
ze.quest.411.task: Reach Y 10,000 at coordinates where both X and Z are 0.
ze.quest.412.title: Steve LV.999
ze.quest.412.subtitle: Reach a Level
ze.quest.412.des: (Mysterious Signal) Go through plenty of experiences, and provide that experience to us.
ze.quest.413.title: Perpetual Motion Machine
ze.quest.413.subtitle: Creative Motor
ze.quest.413.des: Produces infinite rotational force, and you can adjust the speed and direction as you like.
ze.quest.414.title: Infinite Power
ze.quest.414.subtitle: Creative Generator
ze.quest.415.title: Pay to Speed \& Lage
ze.quest.415.subtitle: Upgrade Parts
ze.quest.415.des:
Upgrade Parts: Speed, Efficiency, and Processing boost the machine's operating speed and efficiency when installed.

Upgrade Parts: Range Expansion widens the machine's working range when installed. Each tier adds one block; for example, installing Tier 1 on a machine with a range of one block makes it 3*3, and Tier 2 makes it 5*5.

Note that some machines may not accept upgrade parts.
ze.quest.416.title: Pimp Tech
ze.quest.416.subtitle: Spatial IO Port and Spatial Cell
ze.quest.416.des:
You can store items, fluids, and gases, so why not space itself?

Using the Spatial IO Port as the reference point, set the range of the structure to store along the X, Y, and Z axes with Spatial Pylons. Then put a Spatial Cell of suitable capacity into the IO port and give the port a redstone signal, and it moves that structure into the Spatial Cell for storage. This includes the blocks in range as well as entities (living creatures). Conversely, insert the cell again and give a redstone signal, and it moves the contents back out to fit that range.

Just set it up and run it like in the example picture below. One caveat: treating the Spatial Pylons as a border, it only stores what is inside the pylons. The trapdoor on the dandelion pot in that picture is an example. And don't forget to supply AE power to the IO port.
ze.quest.416.des2: I said living creatures get stored too, right? You should visit the inside of a Spatial Cell at least once. ...If you can come back, that is.
ze.quest.417.title: 3D Printing
ze.quest.417.subtitle: Schematic Table and Schematicannon
ze.quest.417.des:
There's a way to automatically place existing structures, structures from other worlds, or even structures built by other users.

Write that structure's schematic onto an empty schematic using the Schematic Table, set the placement location, put the schematic and the required resources into the Schematicannon, and add gunpowder, and the cannon will start building the structure.

The Schematicannon can pull resources from a chest placed next to it, and you can register a clipboard or book to check the list of required resources.

Build a structure in a test world and save it with a schematic and quill, or drop an .nbt file from the internet into the modpack's schematics folder, and you can load it at the table.

If you're using shaders, the game may crash when handling schematics. We recommend turning shaders off briefly while working with schematics.
ze.quest.418.title: Pay to Speed
ze.quest.418.subtitle: Speed and Energy Upgrades
ze.quest.418.des:
Most Mekanism machines accept upgrades such as Speed and Energy Upgrades, and you can modify them with system-tier upgrades to process a lot at once.

You can check which upgrades apply to each machine by pressing the machine's upgrade button.
ze.quest.419.title: Oil Can
ze.quest.419.subtitle: Metal Barrel
ze.quest.419.des:
Aircraft can use liquid fuel as well as solid fuel. However, liquid fuel has to be in a metal barrel to refuel an aircraft.

You can connect a pipe to the metal barrel's input or fill it directly with a bucket.

For reference, fuels usable in aircraft include biodiesel and regular diesel.
ze.quest.420.title: Matter's Anti-Fan
ze.quest.420.subtitle: Antimatter Pellet
ze.quest.420.des:
(Translated by PDA) Having crafted antimatter proves you are approaching the pinnacle of technology. With antimatter you can convert ordinary materials into rare ones and step into a world of even higher technology.

If you meet the conditions, we would like to give you a chance to escape the Overworld.
ze.quest.421.title: Bait
ze.quest.421.subtitle: Strange Worm
ze.quest.421.des:
(Translated by PDA) This is a joint research project with the Dimensional Ecosystem Research Team: research on an ancient life form living deep in the End.

To lure that ancient creature, you must prepare a Strange Worm to use as bait.

Combine the Crimson Mosquito Proboscis, obtained by killing a Crimson Mosquito, with a Maggot, obtained by killing a Fly, to craft a Crimson Mosquito Larva. Then place a Capsid, obtained by killing an Enderiophage at the edge of the End, put the Crimson Mosquito Larva into it, and after some time it will mutate into a Strange Worm.
ze.quest.422.title: Soul Stone... No Wait, Space Stone?
ze.quest.422.subtitle: Void Worm
ze.quest.422.des:
(Translated by PDA) Throw the Strange Worm you prepared into the End void, and the ancient creature lured by it will reveal itself.

From here on we have no proper data either, but we speculate that the creature can freely open dimensional gates to move around, and when its body is severed, a head grows on the headless side and its numbers increase. Aim for the head as much as you can.

Scan the resources you obtain from it and hand over the data. And... for now, it's probably best that you hold on to those yourself.
ze.quest.423.title: The Watcher
ze.quest.423.subtitle: The Seer
ze.quest.423.des:
(Mysterious Signal) The Overworld has an end. No, not because the Overworld is round or a cuboid, but because it has a border. ...It's not dinosaur-shaped either. And it's not flat.

To reach the border (the Far Lands), you need to get to roughly 30,000,000 on the X or Z coordinate, positive or negative. That's a distance that's hard to reach by walking, running, or even flying. Still, there is a way. One block in the Nether equals 8 blocks in the Overworld. So you only need to travel about 3,750,000 blocks in the Nether. Yeah... that's a hard distance too. So we recommend using the Void Worm remains you have.

With a netherite ingot as the handle, combine a Void Worm Mandible and a Void Worm Eye to craft a Dimensional Carver. It doesn't work as an ordinary pickaxe, but if you hold right-click on thin air, you can open a portal leading to your spawn point. (The air visibly cracks, but you can't see it in a shader environment.) Yes, this feature is pointless. It needs further processing. By the way, if you only use this, it can only be used 20 times in total.

Put the Dimensional Carver into a Capsid, and the Dimensional Carver mutates into a Shattered Dimensional Carver. Hold right-click on thin air with this carver, and you open a portal connected to a place 1,000,000 blocks away in the direction you're facing. Now you can head for the border, right? You only need to use it 3 or 4 times in the Nether. For reference, in this state it can only be used up to 4 times.
ze.quest.423.des2:
Once you've reached the border, you should prepare. (In shader environments error messages cover your screen, after all.) The Seer is stronger than you'd think, and it rarely shows up... It mostly appears in dark places, just like ordinary monsters.

We, and you, need two of the Seer's arms. They're rare, so brace yourself.
ze.quest.424.title: Shameless Equivalent Exchange
ze.quest.424.subtitle: Transmutation Table
ze.quest.424.des:
(Mysterious Signal) If you've gotten into Avaritia technology and are able to kill the Seer, you can craft a Matter Transmuter.

Place an item to sacrifice on it, and by spending experience you can pick from 3 random options to transform it into. Actually, it's not fully random, so there are certain methods to keep duplicating the item you want, but... we'll keep silent about that.

For reference, since this is an unstable technology, if you destroy it, there will be a huge explosion and only a Nether Star will remain.
ze.quest.425.title: Duplication
ze.quest.425.subtitle: Mimic Cube
ze.quest.425.des:
(Translated by PDA) Mimic Cubes that appear around End Cities in the End dimension defend their territory by copying the gear and form of those who approach and counterattacking. Using Mimic Cream obtained by defeating Mimic Cubes, you can exploit their properties to duplicate some gear.

Just combine 8 Mimic Cubes with the gear you want to duplicate. However, the copy isn't perfect, so enchantments like Mending aren't copied, and the duplicated gear comes out at 0 durability, in need of repair.
ze.quest.426.title: High-Volume, Low-Variety Mass Production
ze.quest.426.subtitle: Mass Production
ze.quest.426.des:
(Translated by PDA) The resources you've submitted so far were amounts a single person could handcraft. Your help was certainly valuable, but the Galactic Union is still plagued by endless demand.

Now that we have determined you can mass-produce various goods, we are requesting mass-production goods from you. Since these are large quantities, we recommend submitting them through the task screen.

As a reward, we will provide resources to match.
ze.quest.427.title: You'll Understand When You're an Adult: Cheese Is Insanely Expensive.
ze.quest.427.subtitle: Cheese
ze.quest.427.des: (Translated by PDA) You can make cheese with milk and salt.
ze.quest.428.title: Preparing to Build the Orbital Strike Base
ze.quest.428.des:
(Translated by PDA) As a joint project of the Engineer Team and the Combat Support Team, we will build an orbital strike base that can reach all the way down to the Overworld.

If you supply the materials for building the base, we will grant you the authority to request orbital strikes as well.
ze.quest.429.title: Metal Union
ze.quest.429.des: (Translated by PDA) The materials that make up the main exterior of the orbital strike base.
ze.quest.430.title: Anytime, Anywhere, Rocket Delivery
ze.quest.430.des: (Translated by PDA) The orbital strike we have in mind is not limited to a planet's surface. You can request and receive an orbital strike on those coordinates in any dimension.
ze.quest.431.title: Semiconductor Lump
ze.quest.431.des: (Translated by PDA) A large number of processors are needed to track and calculate the coordinates you request.
ze.quest.432.title: Loud and Clear, Over
ze.quest.432.des: (Translated by PDA) A communications base must also be built so that the orbital strike base can communicate directly with you.
ze.quest.433.title: Big Power Needs a Big Battery
ze.quest.433.des: (Translated by PDA) Not only do orbital strikes demand huge amounts of power, but you also need somewhere to store power to maintain basic communications.
ze.quest.434.title: Earthlings! Lend Me Your Power!
ze.quest.434.des: (Translated by PDA) The orbital strike base is usually powered by sunlight. But for the initial startup, baseline power must be supplied in advance.
ze.quest.435.title: It's Not a Muzzle, But Don't Stare Into It
ze.quest.435.des: (Translated by PDA) This is the laser firing device, the core of the orbital strike. It's a high-output laser by default, but with amplifiers and a tractor beam you can deliver even stronger and more precise strikes.
ze.quest.436.title: Waiting on Construction
ze.quest.436.des: (Translated by PDA) Thanks to you, all the necessary materials are now satisfied. It will take about 6 days in Overworld time.
ze.quest.437.title: Ready to Take Requests!
ze.quest.437.subtitle: Orbital Railgun
ze.quest.437.des:
(Translated by PDA) The orbital strike base has been successfully completed. You can make orbital strike requests with the Orbital Railgun sent to you.

Hold right-click to aim at where you want to strike, then left-click to send the request.

There are safety mechanisms, so it will not destroy blocks in claimed areas where you lack permission.
ze.quest.438.title: Entropy Reversal
ze.quest.438.des:
(Mysterious Signal) We have decided to share access to weapons containing our technology with you. However, our weapons are located much farther from the Overworld, so you will need to help us build similar devices.

The Galactic Union does not know of our existence. We have no need to reveal ourselves to them either. That is why the weapons must be built farther away.
ze.quest.439.title: Little Boat
ze.quest.439.subtitle: Shipbuilding Workbench
ze.quest.439.des:
A regular boat made from 5 wooden planks is a fine way to travel over water, but to build a vessel that can carry more people, more cargo, and even weapons, you need a Dockyard.

Place it somewhere suitable and right-click to build the ship you want.

If a placed ship is nearby, you can repair and upgrade it at the Dockyard.

While aboard a ship, press O to unfurl the sails, and use W and S to adjust the sails and control your sailing speed.
ze.quest.440.title: Galactic Link
ze.quest.440.des: (Mysterious Signal) These devices are required to transmit and receive over long distances, and a dimensional base station is also required for communication between dimensions.
ze.quest.441.title: Semi-Organic Microbot Dispersal
ze.quest.441.des:
(Mysterious Signal) These microbots track down and eliminate living organisms, pursuing their targets with extreme precision and persistence. Even if you hide in a bunker deep underground, the moment you become a target you're already a dead man walking.

These robots run on micro-current cells and need no recharging. With a built-in teleportation core, they approach their target quickly and administer a minuscule dose of Chemical X. The dose is so small that there is no chance of mutation; they only carry out their one goal: elimination.
ze.quest.442.title: Entropy Reversal Protocol
ze.quest.442.des:
(Mysterious Signal) Using the properties of the Last Pearl, this fires a powerful laser beam that annihilates every object and living thing within range. Because of its sheer power, traces of it may remain around the affected area.

A massive amount of power is needed for the first activation. After that, we can handle recharging, so we're counting on you.
ze.quest.443.title: Asteroid Guidance
ze.quest.443.des: (Mysterious Signal) Generates a powerful magnetic force to steer a nearby asteroid to a designated location. The size of the asteroid guided scales with the target range.
ze.quest.444.title: Putting the Fox in Charge of the Henhouse
ze.quest.444.subtitle: Administrator AI
ze.quest.444.des:
(Mysterious Signal) To operate the powerful weapons above accurately and quickly, using an AI is inevitable.

The AI installed there follows the user's commands absolutely. It does not question a single order.
ze.quest.445.des: (Mysterious Signal) All conditions have been met. All that's needed now is time.
ze.quest.446.title: The End of the World
ze.quest.446.subtitle: Entropy Reversal Requester
ze.quest.446.des:
(Mysterious Signal) Construction of the weapon is complete. As promised, we have prepared a requester that lets you use it.

Before you use it, someone has left you a warning. Please check the next page to read it.
ze.quest.446.des2: Unlike the Orbital Railgun, this weapon ignores claim protection. On multiplayer servers with random strangers, we recommend removing this item or adjusting the quest.
ze.crafting.steelC_1_des: How to craft a Steel Casing using Netherite Steel.
ze.crafting.steelC_2_des:
How to craft a Steel Casing using a Petroleum Coke Block instead of Netherite Steel.

Yields two casings.
ze.crafting.steelC_3_des:
How to craft a Steel Casing by infusing Ether Gas in a Melting Chamber and adding AE processors.

Yields five casings.

To easily get Ether Gas from a Wither, you need to hold the Wither still in a Stasis Chamber.
ze.crafting.ammo_1_des: How to craft ammo (TacZ) at the Ammo Workbench.
ze.crafting.ammo_2_des:
How to craft ammo (TacZ), except explosive rounds and shotgun shells, using Sequenced Assembly.

To do so, take the ammo you want, use a brass sheet, gunpowder, and the bullet material matching that round, then finish with pressing. This is more efficient than basic crafting.

Incomplete Ammo refers to ammo that is mid-Sequenced Assembly.
ze.crafting.steel_1_des:
How to smelt steel in a Blast Furnace (Immersive Engineering) using coke or similar as fuel.

One Coke Block can smelt 10 iron. A single regular coke can only smelt one iron ingot, so this is slightly more efficient.
ze.crafting.steel_2_des:
How to smelt steel using the Metallurgic Infuser.

First, infuse an iron ingot with 10 mB of carbon to process it into enriched iron, then infuse another 10 mB of carbon to smelt it into steel dust. After that, you can bake the steel dust in a furnace or similar to get a steel ingot.

It may be more of a hassle than smelting in a Blast Furnace, but by using an Enrichment Chamber to turn a single piece of coal or charcoal (or coke) into enriched carbon, one carbon smelts 4 iron ingots, which is a better yield.
ze.crafting.andCasing_1_des: How to craft an Andesite Casing using Stripped Wood and Andesite Alloy.
ze.crafting.andCasing_2_des:
How to craft an Andesite Casing using Treated Wood and Andesite Alloy.

Yields 4 casings.
ze.crafting.andAlloy_1_des: How to craft Andesite Alloy by combining 2 each of Andesite and Iron Nuggets.
ze.crafting.andAlloy_2_des:
How to craft Andesite Alloy by mixing Andesite and Iron Nuggets in a Mixer.

Here, only one of each Andesite and Iron Nugget is required.
ze.smelting.recycle.tc: Melt metal ores or items to extract the metal.
ze.smelting.alloy.tc: Molten metals can be smelted into alloys.
ze.smelting.alloy.c: Metals can be mixed while heated to a high temperature to smelt them into alloys.
ze.smelting.alloy.ie: Metals can be smelted into alloys at high temperatures.
ze.smelting.crush.tc: Melt metal ores and also collect the byproducts that come out with them.
ze.smelting.crush.c: Grind and wash metal ores to also collect the byproducts.
ze.smelting.crush.ie: Grind metal ores to additionally get that ore's dust as a byproduct.
ze.smelting.crush.ie2: Smelt metal ores at high heat to additionally get that ore's ingot as a byproduct.
ze.smelting.chamber.a: Turns ore into dust, refining it to double.
ze.smelting.chamber.b: Turns ore into clumps, refining it to triple.
ze.smelting.chamber.c: Turns ore into shards, refining it to quadruple.
ze.smelting.chamber.d: Turns ore into slurry, refining it to quintuple.
ze.smelting.chamber.e: Mixes ore with liquefied meat, refining it up to quintuple.
ze.buy.se.des: A Galactic Union technology that lets you put living creatures, including animals, into small eggs. Using the egg releases the creature, and returning it to the egg requires Galactic Union technology.
ze.buy.chi.des: (Translated by PDA) A genetically modified chicken also found in the Overworld. Its features: it can lay eggs regardless of sex, it can breed, and it has a chance to independently lay fertilized eggs.
ze.buy.cow.des: (Translated by PDA) A genetically modified cow also found in the Overworld. Its features: it can be milked with a bucket regardless of sex, and it can breed.
ze.buy.sheep.des: (Translated by PDA) A genetically modified sheep also found in the Overworld. Its features: its wool regrows the instant it eats grass, making it great for shearing, and it can breed regardless of sex.
ze.buy.bee.des: (Translated by PDA) A genetically modified bee also found in the Overworld. Its features: while carrying honey, it sprinkles particles that help plants grow beneath its flight path, and it can breed regardless of sex.
ze.buy.pig.des: (Translated by PDA) A genetically modified pig also found in the Overworld. Its features: it can be saddled and ridden, steered with a carrot on a stick, and it can breed regardless of sex.
ze.buy.cx.des: (Translated by PDA) You need samples of mutant monsters, but if they're hard to find, you can make them artificially yourself. Throw this potion at the monster and it has a high chance of turning into a mutant.
ze.buy.plastic.des:
(Translated by PDA) With plastic, you can craft machines containing our Galactic Union technology.

Instructions will be sent to your PDA along with it. The translation has been done in advance.
ze.buy.tea_seed.des: (Translated by PDA) Grow them into tea plants and steep the leaves to brew tea.
ze.buy.coff_seed.des: (Translated by PDA) Grow coffee bushes and pick the berries to brew coffee.
ze.buy.glu_inject.des:
(Translated by PDA) A glucose syringe injects glucose directly into the body to quickly fill your hunger.

Since it only injects glucose, you won't get the benefits of other nutrients, but it will be useful in an emergency.
ze.buy.nightvision.des: (Translated by PDA) A potion that helps you see brightly in dark places.
ze.buy.exMag.des: (Translated by PDA) Can be loaded with more ammo than a regular magazine.
ze.buy.normal_quartz.des:
(Translated by PDA) This is Flawed Budding Certus Quartz.

Its purity decreases each time the quartz grows.

You must use a tool with Silk Touch to collect this block without lowering its purity.
ze.buy.good_quartz.des:
(Translated by PDA) This is Flawless Budding Certus Quartz.

Its purity never decreases, no matter how much quartz it grows.

However, collecting it with a Silk Touch tool will still lower its purity. Instead, you can retrieve it using methods such as a Create Contraption or a Mekanism Cardboard Box.
ze.buy.slotM.des:
(Translated by PDA) It has no productive value, but it's a fairly popular pastime in the Galactic Union.

Insert credit points into the machine and run it, and you're rewarded based on how many of the three slots' pictures match. A built-in miniature teleporter lets it operate without space constraints.

Rewards are random collectible figures, and if you collect a certain set, you can sell it for a lot of credit points.

Don't get so hooked that you go bankrupt. Remember: 99%% of gamblers quit right before they hit it big. Or so they say.
ze.sell.cx.des:
(Translated by PDA) You can make potions from components obtained from mutant monsters, and those potions can be used to create yet more mutants.

It's dangerous, so if you donate them to our members, we'll give you a modest reward. If possible, please keep donating regularly.
ze.sell.fossil: Go Ahead and Dig. Money.. Actually Comes Out.
ze.sell.fossil.des: (Translated by PDA) If you donate the fossils you've excavated to our union, we promise a modest reward. We need quite a lot of specimens, so ongoing trade would be great.
ze.sell.zero: Figure Enthusiast [Re:Zero - Starting Life in Another World]
ze.sell.zero.des: (Translated by PDA) Who's Rem? Oh wait, best girl. Rem is best girl.
ze.sell.chain.des: (Translated by PDA) Something wasn't quite happy, was it?
ze.sell.lou.des: (Translated by PDA) When is Part 2 coming out?
ze.sell.milkCoffe.des: (Translated by PDA) Add milk to coffee for a smoother taste.
ze.sell.hunneyCoffe.des: (Translated by PDA) Add honey to coffee for a sweet taste.
ze.sell.mhCoffe.des: (Translated by PDA) Milk coffee and honey coffee are usually in high demand. Naturally, we charge more for them too.
item.kubejs.hand.tooltip: The contents are damaged and nothing can be salvaged.
item.kubejs.start_kit.tooltip: Hold it in your hand and press the interact key to get its contents.
item.kubejs.un_ammo.tooltip: Unfinished ammo. Continue by completing Create's Sequenced Assembly.
item.kubejs.money.tooltip: The common currency used when trading with alien worlds.
item.kubejs.transcendent_engineering_par:
§e§oA crystallization of the Galactic Union's technological singularity, and a key material for a spaceship.
Or... a foundation for crafting even more transcendent things.§r
lantern.tooltip: §e§oIf placed, you can sneak and right-click to pick it back up§r
spyglass.tooltip: §e§oHold right-click and scroll the mouse wheel to zoom in/out§r
ze.tip.diet:
If you eat a balanced diet, you can receive various buffs, including max health.
However, nutrients reset upon death. And if your sugar level gets too high, you'll fall into a constant state of hunger.
ze.tip.emi:
If you want to see an item's recipe, search for the item in the search bar at the bottom of the inventory, then click the item shown on the right or press R to view its recipe.
Left-click or press U to see what it's used for.
ze.tip.jade:
Info about the block you're looking at is shown at the top center. If that gets annoying, press Numpad 1 to toggle it on and off.
You can also press Numpad 3 and 4 to see recipes and uses.
ze.tip.skill: Press Alt+` to open the skill screen. You can spend experience to increase each stat.
ze.tip.claim:
Press M to open the full map, then click the claimed chunks button at the top left (hotkey: C) to set the area you want to protect.
Shift-click to also chunk-load it. Left-click to remove protection.
ze.tip.friend:
Open your inventory, click your team icon at the top left, then create a party and invite friends to play with.
If you're in the same party, quest progress is shared, and you can share claimed chunks as well.
ze.tip.galx_comb:
You can communicate with the Galactic Union using a beacon and a radio kit.
Help them to escape the Overworld or reach the ultimate technology.
ze.tip.potato_pc:
The DH (Distant Horizons: A Level of Detail mod) mod and the shader (Complementary Shaders - Unbound) demand hefty specs.
Remove both and you'll gain a lot of frames. Of course, you'll have to give up the visuals. Can it run Minecraft? Barely.
ze.tip.if:
To craft Industrial Foregoing machines, you need the Galactic Union's plastic.
If you're aiming for automation, interact with them as much as you can.
ze.tip.explo:
The Overworld has many structures worth exploring.
If you want, you can take not only the chest contents but also the blocks you need, straight off the structure.
ze.tip.season:
Most biomes are affected by the four seasons.
Day and night lengths change with the season, and certain crops grow better.
ze.tip.moons:
Various kinds of moons can rise at a certain chance.
While those moons are in the sky, swarms of monsters may spawn, crops may harvest better, or your luck may improve.
ze.tip.ending:
This story has two endings.
Escape the Overworld, or reach the ultimate technology. The choice is yours.
ze.tip.shop:
Once you've made contact with the Galactic Union, you can trade with them.
At first there may not be much to trade, but as you help them, you'll be able to exchange for many good things.
ze.tip.tree:
Most trees fall when you chop them down.
Getting hit by a falling tree will almost instantly kill you. Timber!
